title: KYC Update Scam Warning
summary: RBI warns against fraudsters posing as bank officials asking customers to update KYC via links. Banks never send KYC links via SMS or email.
recommendation: Never share OTP, PIN, password, or card details. Visit bank branch for KYC updates. Report suspicious messages to bank immediately.

title: OTP Security Advisory
summary: Never share OTP with anyone claiming to be from bank or any other organisation. OTP is for personal use only and should never be disclosed.
recommendation: OTP should never be shared. Banks never ask for OTP verification over phone or message. Report OTP fraud to 1930 immediately.
